```{r}
library(pheatmap)
library("RColorBrewer")
library(tidyverse)
library(fst)
```

```{r, message=FALSE, warning=FALSE}
renv::status()
renv::snapshot()
```

```{r}
# Load your long-format data
X10_library<- read.csv(file="input/sym10X_01_final_oligo_library.csv")
X10_library<- do.call("data.frame", X10_library)

unique_genes<- X10_library %>% filter(!(uniqueGuideName %in% c("NT_G1", "NT_G2", "NT_G3"))) %>%   dplyr::select(Gene, Transcript_ID) %>% unique()
tracer_x<- read.fst(path = "input/tracerX/2022-10-18_vst_counts.fst")
tracer_x_metadata<- read.csv(file = "input/tracerX/samples_metat_data_for_downstream_analysis.csv")


tracer_x_target<- tracer_x %>% filter(gene_id %in% unique_genes$Gene) %>% droplevels() %>% reshape2::melt()

tracer_x_target<- left_join(tracer_x_target, tracer_x_metadata, by=c("variable"="region"))
 



df <- tracer_x_target %>% filter(!is.na(tracer_x_target$Histology))


```

```{r}


expr_wide <- df %>%
  dplyr::select(gene_id, variable, value) %>%
  pivot_wider(names_from = variable, values_from = value) %>%
  column_to_rownames("gene_id")


annotation_col <- df %>%
  dplyr::select(variable, Histology) %>%
  distinct() %>%
  column_to_rownames("variable")

# Define the desired histology order (Normal first)
histology_order <- c("Normal", sort(setdiff(unique(annotation_col$Histology), "Normal")))


ordered_samples <- c()

for (h in histology_order) {
  samples_h <- rownames(annotation_col)[annotation_col$Histology == h]
  expr_h <- expr_wide[, samples_h, drop = FALSE]

  if (ncol(expr_h) > 1) {
    # Cluster samples within histology
    clust <- hclust(dist(t(expr_h)), method = "complete")
    ordered_samples <- c(ordered_samples, samples_h[clust$order])
  } else {
    # Only one sample: keep as is
    ordered_samples <- c(ordered_samples, samples_h)
  }
}

expr_final <- expr_wide[, ordered_samples]
annotation_final <- annotation_col[ordered_samples, , drop = FALSE]


library(pheatmap)
library(svglite)


plot<-pheatmap(
  expr_final,
  annotation_col = annotation_final,
  cluster_cols = FALSE,   # already ordered by you
  cluster_rows = TRUE,    # gene clustering
  scale = "row",
  show_rownames = TRUE,
  show_colnames = FALSE,
  fontsize = 10,
  color = colorRampPalette(rev(brewer.pal(11, "RdBu")))(100),
  main="Expression of Selected Genes in Tracer X\nAll Sample Histology"
)

ggsave(plot,  file ="graphs/tracerX/heatmap_all_histology.svg", width = 35, height = 15, units = "cm" )



```

```{r}


df_filtered <- df %>%
  filter(Histology %in% c("Normal", "LUAD", "LUSC"))

expr_wide <- df_filtered %>%
  dplyr::select(gene_id, variable, value) %>%
  pivot_wider(names_from = variable, values_from = value) %>%
  column_to_rownames("gene_id")

# Sample annotation
annotation_col <- df_filtered %>%
  dplyr::select(variable, Histology) %>%
  distinct() %>%
  column_to_rownames("variable")

# Desired order
histology_order <- c("Normal", "LUAD", "LUSC")

ordered_samples <- c()

for (h in histology_order) {
  samples_h <- rownames(annotation_col)[annotation_col$Histology == h]
  expr_h <- expr_wide[, samples_h, drop = FALSE]

  if (ncol(expr_h) > 1) {
    clust <- hclust(dist(t(expr_h)), method = "complete")
    ordered_samples <- c(ordered_samples, samples_h[clust$order])
  } else {
    ordered_samples <- c(ordered_samples, samples_h)
  }
}

expr_final <- expr_wide[, ordered_samples]
annotation_final <- annotation_col[ordered_samples, , drop = FALSE]


library(RColorBrewer)

ann_colors <- list(
  Histology = c(
    Normal = "skyblue",
    LUAD = "orange",
    LUSC = "firebrick"
  )
)


plot_2<- pheatmap(
  expr_final,
  annotation_col = annotation_final,
  annotation_colors = ann_colors,
  cluster_cols = FALSE,
  cluster_rows = TRUE,
  scale = "row",
  show_rownames = TRUE,
  show_colnames = FALSE,
  fontsize = 10,
  color = colorRampPalette(rev(brewer.pal(11, "RdBu")))(100),
  main="Expression of Selected Genes in Tracer X\nNormal, LUAD and LUSC Samples"
)


ggsave(plot_2,  file ="graphs/tracerX/heatmap_three_histology.svg", width = 15, height = 15, units = "cm" )
```
